mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, which may increase eslicarbazepine exposure; conversely, eslicarbazepine is a mild CYP3A4 inducer that may decrease cimetidine levels.
action: Monitor for eslicarbazepine toxicity (dizziness, diplopia, ataxia); consider alternative H2-receptor antagonist (famotidine) or adjust eslicarbazepine dose if cimetidine is necessary.
